consequence.statement: New image signature verification using sigstore bundle format becomes available; environments can now verify GitHub Artifact Attestations with SigstoreBundle verification type.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13 adds support for verifying container image signatures using the sigstore bundle format, enabling verification of GitHub Artifact Attestations via the SigstoreBundle verification type.
